scope: Offline deterministic Persona acceptance fixture: 28 simulated days, 20 generated activities/day, seed 459, learning enabled. Not 28 real days, a paid-provider test, or validation against existing user workspaces.

identity.scope: Local synthetic final-source snapshot, not an upstream commit or release

criteria.summary: 560/560 generated inputs became coherent terminal Activities.

threshold.description: All generated inputs complete; acceptance uses exactly 28 days x 20 activities/day.

criteria.summary: Generated source IDs were reconciled to the expected ingress mailbox records and one terminal Activity.

threshold.description: Every generated input is accepted; no missing, duplicate, nonterminal, false-success, mailbox-link, Persona, or revision mismatch.
threshold.source: Issue #489 required fix 1 and acceptance criterion 2

criteria.summary: All 5 scheduled faults executed and recovered.

threshold.description: Every scheduled fault emits passed before/fault/after evidence.
Final recall precision is within 5 percentage points of day 1.

criteria.summary: Measured production search p95=3.41 ms at soak scale; the controlled 50k gate runs separately.

threshold.description: p95 is strictly less than 150 ms; the release-scale 50k fixture is validated by the controlled benchmark.
threshold.source: Issue #459 acceptance criterion 3 and issue #489 required fix 6

criteria.summary: All detailed runtime collections stayed within their committed total and uncompacted-record caps.

threshold.description: Every reported collection has at most 1248 total records; uncompacted maxima are mailboxItems<=500, activities<=200, flowDispatches<=200, leaseHistory<=50; missing or new uncontracted collections fail closed.

criteria.failureReason: Baseline-window median p95=17.59 ms, final-window median p95=18.33 ms, maximum daily p95=169.69 ms.
criteria.summary: Baseline-window median p95=17.59 ms, final-window median p95=18.33 ms, maximum daily p95=169.69 ms.

threshold.description: The final seven-day median append p95 is no more than 2x the first seven-day median (with a 20 ms noise floor), and every daily p95 is strictly below 150 ms.

criteria.summary: 1732 retained production runtime events and all daily retention checkpoints had continuous sequence ranges and unique IDs.

threshold.description: Each retained range is internally continuous and every daily range overlaps or directly follows the prior checkpoint; event IDs are unique.

criteria.summary: 0 overlapping acquisitions were found across daily pre-pruning lease snapshots.

threshold.description: Zero overlapping live lease intervals and one unique fencing token per observed acquisition for one Persona.
Zero stranded leases and zero stuck Personas after the run.

criteria.summary: Resident-memory final growth=109064192 bytes; peak=483946496 bytes.

threshold.description: Final RSS growth is at most 256 MiB from day 1 and peak RSS is at most 768 MiB.

criteria.summary: A persisted regression rolled the active Behavior binding back to its base revision.

threshold.description: Regression verdict is rolled_back and the active binding returns to the base revision.

criteria.summary: A killed child process safely terminalized uncertain work without replay or a stranded lease.

threshold.description: Killed-worker recovery fails closed without replay, duplicate completion, or a live lease.

timingDiagnosis.explanation: Day 12 event-append P95 exceeded the existing 150 ms daily ceiling. The nearest-rank P95 of five daily samples is their maximum. Day 12 also exercised graceful restart; temporal correlation does not establish a cause. No threshold was weakened, no source changed during the run, and no rerun was performed to obtain a passing result.

previousAttempt.reason: Concurrent build/full CI/soak made performance context invalid; first-day event-append P95 249.2073ms exceeded unchanged150ms cap. Retain partial evidence, rerun same frozen SHA only after quiet-host authorization.

postSnapshotDrift.explanation: The final build generated a next-env.d.ts type import after snapshot capture; it has no runtime effect. Audit documentation and evidence were finalized while the frozen soak ran. Exact differences are listed, so this result remains tied to its synthetic SHA.
postSnapshotDrift.hashScope: observedSha256 records bytes at checkedAt, before publication sanitization and subsequent release-note edits; it is not a checksum of the current public documentation.

limitations: The synthetic local Git commit includes the current working changes and is not upstream HEAD, a published package, or a released installer.
The completion adapter and learning candidate compiler are deterministic local fixtures; learning evidence verifies the configured automatic rollback path, not model learning quality.
Windows timing measurements failed one committed numeric criterion. Successful workload/recovery checks do not turn this into an overall acceptance pass.
Provider credentials were excluded from the child environment; temporary home, data, filesystem roots and process-crash sandboxes were used.

publicationPrivacy.artifactPathPolicy: remediation/ and persona-soak/ paths identify files relative to a local evidence bundle; toolchain/ identifies local executables. Raw artifacts and exact pre-sanitization audit originals are retained locally and are not included in this repository.
publicationPrivacy.hashPolicy: originalRawSha256 identifies unchanged raw artifact bytes retained locally. sha256 on included repository files identifies their public bytes. Source and snapshot hashes retain their original measured scope; this sanitization is not a new validation run.
redactions: Local user-specific absolute paths replaced by repository-relative or artifact-relative paths.
